items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: I put on Art Blakey with Wynton Marsalis.

ctx.x: Well, to wrap up here, what’s your feeling about the near future of jazz?

Hmm. The near future of jazz. That’s a good question. You know when I was here I had a radio show on WHCL and my very last show, the very last two songs I played, I said well what’s the future of jazz going to be like. This was like ’85 you know, spring of ’85. And I said some people say it’s going to be like this, and I played Jean-Luc Ponty with his guitar doing something that was very fusionesque. And I said but I kind of would like it to be like this — and I put on Art Blakey with Wynton Marsalis. Swinging…
Yeah. It’s not easy to be simple.
